excluded_and_why.same-day Revenue/Units/Margin/prices: These are the outcome or are realized with the sale. Using them to predict same-day revenue is leakage.
excluded_and_why.Stock_On_Hand / Reorder_Level / Lead_Tim: Inventory fields are recorded at invoice level. Aggregating them to a daily category forecast grain is ambiguous, and same-day stock is not treated as known at prediction time.
excluded_and_why.Customer_Age / Customer_Gender / Loyalty: Future customer mix is not known in advance. Age is also ~40% missing and is never imputed.
excluded_and_why.Brand / Channel / Store_Format / City /: Not part of the selected Date × Category grain. Used in analytics and for top-down allocation shares, not as contemporaneous XGBoost features.

rolling_implementation: All rolling statistics use revenue.shift(1).rolling(window) so the current target is excluded.
